column1: # Codec vectors: name, raw field, encoded field.
# Both fields use %XX for bytes below 0x20, for 0x5C and 0x7F, and for %25.
# Nothing else is interpreted. Non-ASCII text stays unescaped. All %XX escapes
# are ASCII and can be decoded without knowing the file encoding.
# Supported line editors cannot produce NUL, and it terminates gawk's C strings.
# NUL is outside the store contract. Every other byte below 0x20, plus 0x7F,
# must survive a round trip unchanged.
